question: What is the central theme of the passage?

options.text: The similarities between Darcy and Bingley
The contrast between Bingley and Darcy

solution:
The correct answer is "**The contrast between Bingley and Darcy**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **central theme of the passage** is the contrast between **Bingley and Darcy**, specifically their **personalities and how they approach social situations**.
 
• While Bingley is **outgoing and well-liked by everyone**, **Darcy is reserved** and **often gives offense**.
 
• **Despite their differences**, they **maintain a steady friendship** and **respect each other's opinions**.
 
• The passage also touches on their **differing perspectives** on the **Meryton assembly** and the **character of the people they met there**.

Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer.
